_comment: Golden for finding (a). SAOC host static routes in the sitemap, as paths ('' is the home page). Dynamic /societies/[slug] and /events/[slug] stay Sanity-driven in app/sitemap.ts and are not listed here.

exclude./members: The members area has no portal yet; the page says so. Listing it invites a crawl of an empty page.
exclude./events/submit: Members-only form. Its metadata is robots noindex, so listing it would send a sitemap-says-index, page-says-noindex contradiction, and a crawler fetching it is shown a sign-in wall.
exclude./media-kit: Deliberately gated (lib/media-kit-gate.ts): a visitor is redirected 307 to /admin/login. Never list it.
exclude./newsletter/unsubscribe: Token-driven utility page reached from an email link, not public content.
